archive.recipe: https://github.com/Shenggan/xfold/archive/22bdeedfa309ef4ff6f9199910d8403915de69d6.tar.gz (GitHub's archive of the commit; member prefix xfold-22bdeedfa309ef4ff6f9199910d8403915de69d6/)
archive.install: stock/fetch_upstream.py (run by `run.sh install`): present in the tree, or fetched from the recipe's URL when the tree arrives without it; read by the stock route (`run.sh stock`) and the kit's byte tests only — no run mode opens it

patches.reason: correctness under the OpenFold3 weights: the ported template aatype embeddings were trained on GAP one-hots for absent template slots; ALA one-hots on all N^2 pairs of the 4 padded slots bias interface confidences (the reference fork's report §5.3); declared as a patch on the carried kit — both arms, the stock CLI runs on this package
patches.what: with the OpenFold3 weights (xfold.of3.OF3), absent (padding) template slots are featurised as GAP (restype index 21, OpenFold3's convention) instead of restype 0 (ALA) in SingleTemplateEmbedding.construct_input (template_restype_for_one_hot); a slot with any atom present and the AlphaFold 3 layout are unchanged
patches.applies: patch -p1 in opt/forward/af3t/; the touched file is otherwise the xfold archive member (it is not one of upstream.port's changed files)

patches.reason: an out-of-memory error is the user's to see, never a reason to run a different kernel: the kit adapter's kernel-error route (a lever whose kernel raises is disabled for the process and the stock path serves) must not swallow a CUDA OOM
patches.what: af3_kernels.py imports the shared core's one recogniser (`from opt_core.oom import is_oom`) and every `except Exception as e:` handler that routes to `_kernel_error` (trimul, triattn, transition, selfattn/apb, apb pair logits, the pairformer graph capture, the diffusion-transformer prologue and graph capture — 8 handlers) begins with `if is_oom(e): raise`; every non-OOM exception takes the kernel-error route unchanged
patches.applies: patch -p1 in opt/forward/af3t/ on kernels/af3_kernels.py (a kit-original file, outside the xfold upstream archive)

reference.name: alphafold3-open (sokrypton fork)

patch.what: the OpenFold3 empty-template convention on the fork's side (absent template slots featurised as GAP under of3 weights; alphafold3/model/network/template_modules.py) — applied to the source tree before the wheel is built (environment/Dockerfile); the tested stack's JAX venv and /app/alphafold carry exactly this change (`patch -p1` in the fork's top directory)

reference.role: featurisation and the output writers (the image's JAX venv; featurise.py / postprocess.py), and the weight converter (convert_of3_weights.py at the checkout root: variants.p2.converter)

artefacts.note: binary files of the tested stack with no public URL, read by environment/Dockerfile's prebuilt route (--build-arg WHEELS_FROM=prebuilt) from stock/wheels/ and checked against these digests (README.md 'Setup' says where they come from); the default route makes both from the fork's source at `commit` instead — the wheel by the fork's own build, the data by its `build_data` step, whose pickles are not byte-stable across runs

files.what: alphafold3-open 3.1.4: the fork built as a wheel for CPython 3.12 / x86-64 Linux (scikit-build-core; one compiled extension, alphafold3/cpp; libcifpp's components.cif inside) with the OpenFold3 empty-template convention in alphafold3/model/network/template_modules.py (STOCK.md) — the package of the JAX venv (environment/requirements-jax.lock names it, installed --no-deps)

the chemical-components data AlphaFold 3's `build_data` step writes into the installed package (alphafold3/constants/converters/ccd.pickle, ccd_codes.txt, chemical_component_sets.pickle; paths relative to site-packages), as generated in the tested stack — the step's pickles are not byte-stable across runs, so its output ships instead of the step

image.tested_on: the pinned stack `9.0|2.13.0+cu130` — Ubuntu 24.04.1 LTS; torch venv: torch 2.13.0+cu130 / triton 3.7.1; JAX venv: Python 3.12.1, jax 0.10.2 + sokrypton/alphafold3 @ bc32b22f with stock/patches/04_equivalent_template_gap.diff applied to alphafold3/model/network/template_modules.py (the fork's haiku template network, which this kit's JAX-venv steps import but never execute); NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, driver 580.95.05, cc 9.0 — documentation only: nothing reads or compares this line
image.env_note: the fork's XLA variables (its own docker environment's), set by the package on the JAX-venv processes; those run on CPU (JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu) — the torch process owns the GPU

check_packages._note: distribution versions as importlib.metadata reports them (what check_pins.py queries); torch's build string is 2.13.0+cu130 (image.tested_on)

p2.name: OpenFold3-preview2

checkpoint.what: the public OpenFold3-preview2 training checkpoint (a torch state dict; `run.sh install --weights DIR --fetch` downloads it into DIR/checkpoint/ and checks this digest before converting)

converter.what: the reference fork's own converter at `reference.commit` (OpenFold3-preview2 state dict -> AlphaFold 3's parameter-record format, of3_ported_weights.bin.zst, EMA weights); it needs the JAX venv's torch (CPU build, environment/requirements-jax.lock) and zstandard and runs on the CPU in about two minutes; af3_torch_opt/weights.py fetch_and_convert drives it

p2.source: the public OpenFold3-preview2 checkpoint (`checkpoint`) converted by the reference fork's converter (`converter`) — `run.sh install --weights DIR --fetch` does both and judges the result against `converted`; a file converted elsewhere and placed in DIR is judged the same way (`run.sh install --weights DIR`)

hardware.gate: one CUDA device; the kit carries no kernel cell table (tests/test_kit_bytes.py holds this block empty; the shared core's providers carry the per-card cells)
hardware.triangle_attention: no kit cell table: the shared core's triangle-attention provider (opt_core.kernels.triattn) carries the per-card cells and lever triattn asks it for the mode's tier word (fast | big) at every (card, dtype, head dim, heads, size) cell
